verdict.rationale: Letta documents an --ephemeral CLI mode that runs a one-shot task without creating, resuming, or persisting an agent, memory blocks, or MemFS, plus a default cloud sandbox for the web app and local-only mode that stores state on-device without a login — all supporting isolated, non-production testing. However, there's no explicit first-party guidance framing this as a formal 'sandbox vs production' distinction, no isolation/security guarantees, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that ephemeral runs never touch persisted/production data. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox-vs-production documentation, isolation guarantees, independent verification of ephemeral mode's non-persistence.
